title: Asean BAC highlights its role in scaling up MSMEs

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Jose Maria Concepcion, the chair of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Business and Advisory Council (BAC), concluded the Asean Business and Investment Summit with a commitment to “remain the bridge between government and business, turning dialogue into investments, partnerships and measurable outcomes.” Speaking to business and industry leaders, Concepcion emphasized the role of the private sector in empowering micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs), farmers, women, and young entrepreneurs as Asean leaders bring forward key agreements and declarations on the digital economy and energy and food security. “Across these conversations, one message stands out.
